rungs.name: r1_abs
rungs.change: MLP predicts log trip energy directly (physics integrals only as inputs); RoadSim physics v2, raw simulated energy

rungs.name: r2_corr
rungs.change: predict a correction to the generic road-load physics estimate
rungs.why: val2[a] skill 0.629 vs 0.614 (d +0.016); dev D2 0.1327 vs 0.1376 (d -0.0049); val skill must rise by > 0.01, dev D2 may not rise by > 0.01

rungs.name: r3_lab
rungs.change: RoadSim's OBD label model (roadsim.obd.label_fuel: MAF fuel-cut air, missed enrichment) for MAF-estimated fuel; flag input
rungs.why: val2[b] skill 0.630 vs 0.628 (d +0.003); dev D2 0.1234 vs 0.1327 (d -0.0093); physics rung: dev D2 must improve by > 0.01; own-version skill 0.630 vs incumbent's 0.629 on its own version (may not drop by > 0.01); first rule: rejected

rungs.name: r4_rw
rungs.change: v1's dev-fitted on-road loads wrapper on top of v2 (v2 already carries its own on-road load)
rungs.why: val2[c] skill 0.631 vs 0.534 (d +0.097); dev D2 0.1378 vs 0.1327 (d +0.0050); physics rung: dev D2 must improve by > 0.01; own-version skill 0.631 vs incumbent's 0.629 on its own version (may not drop by > 0.01); first rule: kept

rungs.name: r5_phev
rungs.change: v1's plug-in hardware patch on the generated plug-ins (pack power >= 1.2 x motor, resistance / 2.5, MG2 torque x 1.8); dev twin read: the network put the dev plug-ins 33% above their own RoadSim twins
rungs.why: val2[f] skill 0.626 vs 0.622 (d +0.005); dev D2 0.1228 vs 0.1327 (d -0.0100); physics rung: dev D2 must improve by > 0.01; own-version skill 0.626 vs incumbent's 0.629 on its own version (may not drop by > 0.01); first rule: rejected

rungs.name: r5b_labphev
rungs.change: both near-misses together: RoadSim's OBD label model (r3) and the plug-in patch (r5), each of which improved D2 by just under 0.01 alone
rungs.why: val2[e] skill 0.632 vs 0.619 (d +0.013); dev D2 0.1225 vs 0.1327 (d -0.0102); physics rung: dev D2 must improve by > 0.01; own-version skill 0.632 vs incumbent's 0.629 on its own version (may not drop by > 0.01); first rule: kept

rungs.name: r6_ens
rungs.change: ensemble of 5 networks (seeds); sigma includes their spread
rungs.why: val2[e] skill 0.636 vs 0.632 (d +0.004); dev D2 0.1259 vs 0.1225 (d +0.0033); val skill must rise by > 0.01, dev D2 may not rise by > 0.01

rungs.name: r7_era
rungs.change: model-year input (VED: fueleconomy.gov models matched to the car; EPA: test year); the fleet's engine efficiency follows the fueleconomy.gov dev era trend, so the network can tell a 2006 car from a 2022 one
rungs.why: val2[e] skill 0.651 vs 0.632 (d +0.019); dev D2 0.1260 vs 0.1225 (d +0.0035); val skill must rise by > 0.01, dev D2 may not rise by > 0.01

rungs.name: r8_epahyb
rungs.change: EPA test-car hybrids told their hybrid system (P2 / power-split / series, from the model line; RoadSim's public spec-sheet table) instead of 'power-split' for all; the same networks
rungs.why: val2[e] skill 0.651 vs 0.651 (d +0.000); dev D2 0.1195 vs 0.1260 (d -0.0065); gate-only rung: dev D2 must improve by > 0.01, val skill may not drop by > 0.01

rungs.name: r9_bus
rungs.change: ZTBus told the trolleybus's published curb mass (19 t, 'reported' mass) instead of the class prior (15 t); the same networks
rungs.why: val2[e] skill 0.651 vs 0.651 (d +0.000); dev D2 0.1239 vs 0.1260 (d -0.0021); gate-only rung: dev D2 must improve by > 0.01, val skill may not drop by > 0.01

rungs.name: r9b_inputs
rungs.change: both public-spec inputs together (r8 EPA hybrid system + r9 bus curb mass), each short of the margin alone
rungs.why: val2[e] skill 0.651 vs 0.651 (d +0.000); dev D2 0.1174 vs 0.1260 (d -0.0086); gate-only rung: dev D2 must improve by > 0.01, val skill may not drop by > 0.01

rungs.name: r10_epalab
rungs.change: simulated window-sticker labels by RoadSim's EPA procedure emulation (FTP-75 with hot soak, hybrids preconditioned and corrected for net battery energy) instead of fleet.py's shortcut; physics rung (labels change)
rungs.why: val2[e+L] skill 0.640 vs 0.649 (d -0.009); dev D2 0.1277 vs 0.1260 (d +0.0016); physics rung: dev D2 must improve by > 0.01; own-version skill 0.640 vs incumbent's 0.651 on its own version (may not drop by > 0.01); first rule: rejected

rungs.name: r11_big
rungs.change: GPU: twice the simulated data (a second bank of 28,800 trips on the same fleet, new seed), wider networks (512 units, 0.73M weights each) and 100 epochs
rungs.why: val2[e] skill 0.632 vs 0.651 (d -0.019); dev D2 0.1219 vs 0.1260 (d -0.0041); val skill must rise by > 0.01, dev D2 may not rise by > 0.01

rungs.name: r11b_data
rungs.change: twice the simulated data only (both banks, 57,600 trips), networks and training as r7
rungs.why: val2[e] skill 0.660 vs 0.651 (d +0.009); dev D2 0.1195 vs 0.1260 (d -0.0065); val skill must rise by > 0.01, dev D2 may not rise by > 0.01

rungs.name: r13_data3
rungs.change: three times the simulated data (three banks on the same fleet, 86,400 trips), networks and training as r7
rungs.why: val2[e] skill 0.670 vs 0.651 (d +0.019); dev D2 0.1195 vs 0.1260 (d -0.0065); val skill must rise by > 0.01, dev D2 may not rise by > 0.01
